advice_items.quote: Hyper focus on intention and ignore distraction. Intention is anything that moves the needle in your favor.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay hyper-focused on actions that move the needle and ruthlessly ignore distractions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高度专注核心意图，屏蔽一切无关干扰

advice_items.quote: Middle-class people think the primary purpose of money is to maintain good credit so they can buy things they can't afford to impress people they don't know or like.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid going into debt or buying status symbols to impress strangers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别为取悦他人而透支信用去买面子消费品

advice_items.quote: Rich people believe the primary purpose of money is to turn into more money... when I get a dollar I want to turn it into 10 or preferably 100.
advice_items.summary_en: Treat every dollar as capital meant to multiply rather than be spent.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把钱当成资本滚雪球，追求十倍百倍增值

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: You have to solve somebody else's problem in order to solve your money problem, and you can't be focused on your money problem when you're solving it.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus entirely on solving other people's problems and creating value; income follows.
advice_items.summary_zh: 聚焦解决他人的真实痛点，金钱自然随之而来

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: I upgraded my lifestyle way too soon... if you can live off of 10% of your income, now you're in a place where the bottom can fall out and you're still going to be okay.
advice_items.summary_en: Resist upgrading your lifestyle too early; live on a small fraction of your income to stay resilient.
advice_items.summary_zh: 切忌过早消费升级，只花收入的一成留足缓冲

advice_items.quote: Keep the expenses low even when the margins and the profits are high... you want to make sure that the business is sustained first.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep business overhead low even during high-margin periods and retain capital to sustain growth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 高利润时仍要压低开支，优先留存资金养业务

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: It's easier to create wealth in the economic era that you're living in... right now we are in the AI age.
advice_items.summary_en: Build in the defining industry of your current economic era, such as AI today.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应当前AI时代浪潮，在风口行业创造财富

advice_items.quote: Have an objective for input, an objective for outcomes, but don't put a time limit on it so you're not feeling like a failure and quitting.
advice_items.summary_en: Set input and outcome objectives without arbitrary deadlines that breed discouragement and quitting.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只设行动与结果目标，不设死线避免自我挫败

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: Income follows assets, so I stopped focusing on 8 hours work for 8 hours pay... how can I put more assets in my asset column.
advice_items.summary_en: Shift from trading time for wages to buying and building assets like books that pay you repeatedly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 停止用时间换薪酬，转向购买和打造生息资产

advice_items.quote: The most important thing I've ever invested in is my own mind to learn the things I don't know so I can do the things I couldn't do before.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize investing in your own mind and skills to unlock new capabilities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资自身大脑是核心，持续学习掌握未知能力

advice_items.quote: Mentorship is like the ultimate shortcut. Somebody's already spent their whole life figuring out how to do something and they charge you some money to teach you.
advice_items.summary_en: Pay for proven mentors to compress decades of trial and error into an actionable shortcut.
advice_items.summary_zh: 花钱请教导师是最快捷径，直接吸收前人经验

advice_items.quote: You have to think a lot bigger and you have to learn to perceive the big things that are already there all around you.
advice_items.summary_en: Expand your mental ceiling and train yourself to recognize abundant opportunities around you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打破思维局限，学会看见并接纳更大的财富体量

advice_items.quote: You pay to be in the room, you buy your way into the room, and you get paid on the way out of the room.
advice_items.summary_en: Invest to get into high-level masterminds and rooms where wealthier peers recognize your value.
advice_items.summary_zh: 花钱挤进高净值圈层，在顶级社群中获得回报

advice_items.quote: If you want to get rich, sell to rich people... it takes no more energy to sell a million-dollar offer than it does to sell a $1,000 offer.
advice_items.summary_en: Sell high-ticket value offers upfront to affluent buyers who already want and can afford them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 向有钱且有需求的人销售高客单价值方案

advice_items.quote: Prove to people that you can help them by actually helping them... people pay you long enough with their attention, they'll eventually pay you with their assets.
advice_items.summary_en: Consistently publish free helpful content to earn audience attention, which later converts into paying clients.
advice_items.summary_zh: 持续免费输出高价值内容，用注意力换取变现

advice_items.quote: Live every day with gratitude in your heart... everything good in my life is a gift.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay grounded in gratitude, love the people around you, and serve as many people as possible.
advice_items.summary_zh: 心怀感恩并服务大众，把每一天都当成礼物

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年曾做垃圾清运工（时薪6.25美元），16岁受父亲辞职单干启发立志创业；45岁赚到第一个百万美元，却因过早升级消费且遭遇家庭变故亏光；后通过重金跟随导师学习一对多舞台销售，并转向积累资产而非出卖时间，最终实现年入1500万美元。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Robert G. Allen (Multiple Streams of Income)
guests.zero_start_advice: 拒绝设定“90天暴富”类带死线的目标（避免未达预期引发挫败感而放弃），建议从专注解决他人真实痛点入手，用免费高价值内容获取注意力、向具备支付能力的高净值人群提供高客单方案，并花钱进入高水平圈层学习与链接。
